source_name: GitHub REST API (issues and repository metadata endpoints)
source_class_note: First-party API used within its terms. Not a directory, aggregator or competitor (Class E), and access is through the documented API, not scraping.
terms_or_license_reference: https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/acceptable-use-policies/github-acceptable-use-policies (Section 7, Information Usage Restrictions: public, non-personal information may be used for research when resulting publications are open access)
data_classes_kept: issue number, state, labels, created/updated/closed timestamps
comment count and total reaction count
issue title truncated to 15 words or fewer, always shown with its source link
bag of stemmed terms derived from title and body (local database only, never published)
data_classes_excluded: issue body text (read in memory for term extraction, never persisted)
author login, assignees, avatars, emails or any other personal data
commercial_use_note: Treated as non-commercial. Open-access research and demo use only. Not to be shipped to an ad-supported, lead-generation or paid surface without a new review.
destination_property: developer-opportunity-radar (public GitHub repo, GitHub Pages dashboard, read-only Vercel demo API)
approval_record: Repo owner approved in the Claude Code session of 2026-11-12 (answer: "Approve" to the source-gate question). Drafted by Claude; decision field transcribed from that answer.
